description: Expand an RRULE or 5-field cron into concrete occurrences with DST handling, exclusions and conflict detection — Expands an RFC 5545 RRULE (FREQ DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY/YEARLY, INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYDAY with ordinals, BYMONTHDAY, BYMONTH, BYSETPOS, WKST; DTSTART with TZID; EXDATE) or a crontab(5) expression into up to 366 occurrences in a time zone, with the UTC instant of each, DST gap or overlap flags, caller blackout dates, a plain-English reading, and optionally the occurrences where it collides with a

blackouts.description: Inclusive local date ranges to drop (holidays, freezes).

dtstart.description: Local DTSTART when the rule text has none.

exdates.description: Extra excluded local date-times (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]) or dates (YYYY-MM-DD, excludes that day).

from.description: Local start of the output window; required for cron, default DTSTART for rrule.

other.description: A second rule to compare; conflicts are occurrences whose intervals overlap (equal instants when both durations are 0).

rule.description: rrule: 'DTSTART;TZID=America/New_York:19970902T090000\nRRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=10\nEXDATE;TZID=America/New_York:19970903T090000' or just 'FREQ=...' with dtstart. cron: '*/15 9-17 * * 1-5' (dom and dow both restricted match if either does).

timeZone.description: IANA zone for local times (required for cron; for rrule unless DTSTART has TZID or Z).

to.description: Local end of the window, inclusive.

name: recurrence-expand
